text_post: The first clip (polite pac) is currently popular on reddit and shows tupac talking about how his politeness to women rewards him with friendships. The juxtaposition between this first approach and the later clips shows the ‘nice guy’ to ‘asshole’ transition that many men go through as they continue to spend year after year alone watching women f~~~ other guys. I think there is a core issue here which is rarely addressed and is central to my own personal interpretation of MGTOW. Whether or not tupac was ever actually a ‘nice guy’ is debatable, but women clearly favor more impulsive, aggressive, ‘exciting’ guys in their younger years. Women attempt to explain this as a ‘phase’ of their life which results from immaturity when in reality it results from women having the power in the marketplace. Women in their late 30’s-50’s can be seen desperately clinging to their attractiveness with a passion as they yearn for the years when they COULD and DID have the pick of whatever men they wanted. I think this is strong evidence that women never actually grow out of this ‘phase’ and always reward the more impulsive and aggressive guys. The human brain is done developing by ~25 years old. What you have at that point is all you get hardware wise. These women struggling more than a decade later to hold onto their leverage shows their true desires. How does this pan out in male lives? The average guy’s life is years spent as a polite well-mannered man who lacks confidence and attempts to treat everyone as well as possible while never uttering the phrase ‘no’. After years and years of watching what seems to be the worst of what masculinity has to offer having all the success with women, men are forever damaged and changed. We are humans. Adapting is what we do best. So we grow colder. Bolder. We call women ‘bitches’. We give our aid sparingly and act primarily for our own interest. And in the wake of this shift, women then start to treat us paradoxically, with respect. And in times like this, PUA and TRP forums serve as guides for how to play the game women seemingly want men to play. They enjoy the chase. The ‘game’. Keep her guessing! Be borderline abusive! If you don’t she’ll just get it somewhere else! While I don’t disagree or agree with PUA and TRP, I do think they miss a central point. Women are simply on average not worth interacting with. They have bent the incentives to such a degree that many guys out there simply don’t feel like playing anymore. Instead of being angry with women and focusing our whole life philosophy around how to best talk to them and understand their motives, we should move on to life’s other pleasures while we still walk the earth.
